question: What was the yearly trend in import volume (kg) of the top 3 mineral fuel products (HS4) identified in Luxembourg from 2018 to 2023?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2716', '3606', '4401')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: −22.7 % (2018–2023)
insight: The yearly trend in import volume of the top 3 mineral fuel products in Luxembourg decreased from 183.4 million kilograms in 2018 to 141.7 million kilograms in 2023.
The total import volume fell by 22.7% over this period.
The highest import volume was recorded in 2021, reaching 193.4 million kilograms.
This trend shows a peak in 2021 followed by a decline to 2023 levels.
The data only includes quantities for trade rows with known quantities, so some volumes may be missing.
